audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Strong-compatible local two-building product is false; The prime3 cell construction is not homogeneous; Partial-order proof uses non-invariant quotient and wrong kernel
limitations: M25-0184-P01 — Strong-compatible local two-building product is false — Counterevidence: P+Q' is a direct summand, so Lemma7.10 is not false. The new weak diagram has a provable product and contractible covering fibers.

M25-0184-P02 — The prime3 cell construction is not homogeneous — Counterevidence: Lemma9.2 and initial operation-power paragraph supply correct degrees. Full corrected chain b(2,3),rho(3,4),barb(2,4),u(3,4),barrho(3,5) yields dr=u and correct Koszul homology.

M25-0184-P03 — Partial-order proof uses non-invariant quotient and wrong kernel — Counterevidence: Actual homology conclusion follows from corrected kernel GL(M_t) semidirectHom(M_t,U) and restriction to invariantM'.

M25-0184-P04 — Stable-rank image quotient is incorrectly identified with a whole layer — Counterevidence: TheoremB/Cor6.12 layer computation and weak finiteness survive; adjacent topology remark does not change discrete-field example.

M25-0184-P05 — Ring pre-Bloch generators omit complement-unit condition — Counterevidence: Actual complementary-line configuration proof already forces admissible symbols; Section9.2 Milnor definition correct; fielddomain unchanged.

M25-0184-P06 — Finite-field extension of adjoint proof uses false full-Hom injection — Counterevidence: T is not GL-equivariant; exact81-matrix centralizer is0,I,2I,soCorDtrue in test. Infinitefield proof valid with correct(iv) reference.

M25-0184-P07 — Ancillary finite-dimensional-submodule claim misses rank one — Counterevidence: Indecomposability forbids nonzero proper summands, not whole module; F infinite anddim>=2 make whole St infinite-dimensional.
